newsAll.head: Jayden Daniels: Could need surgery after season
newsAll.body: Daniels will avoid a procedure on his dislocated left elbow for the time being, but Adam Schefter of ESPN reports that the quarterback could undergo surgery after the season.

newsAll.head: Kyle Monangai: Kept in check during win
newsAll.body: Monangai rushed 10 times for 31 yards and wasn't targeted in the Bears' 27-7 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

newsAll.head: Colston Loveland: Slight uptick in production Monday
newsAll.body: Loveland secured all four targets for 31 yards in the Bears' 27-7 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

newsAll.head: Rome Odunze: Three more catches in win
newsAll.body: Odunze secured three of six targets for 44 yards in the Bears' 27-7 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

newsAll.head: Luther Burden: Scores TD on productive night
newsAll.body: Burden secured seven of 11 targets for 61 yards and a touchdown while rushing once for seven yards in the Bears' 27-7 win over the Eagles on Monday night.
